answer: Tie voting weight to stake that unbonds slowly, then make grading seats random per epoch. A sybil operator can forge a thousand keys cheaply, but each needs locked collateral, and a key caught grading in lockstep with its siblings loses that bond. Correlated scores are a strong signal of shared control even when every key looks clean on its own, so no cipher hides the pattern. Spreading capital thin across fakes then earns less than one honest, well-bonded seat.
